aggregation_policy: No single failure automatically becomes global model falsification unless an explicit preregistered escalation rule says so.

rules.condition: Frozen out-of-sample prediction fails its preregistered test rule.
rules.scope: the failed test unless an escalation rule is separately preregistered

rules.condition: Apparent advantage disappears across credible preregistered nuisance/covariance scenarios.
An equally or less complex baseline predicts held-out data equally well or better under the frozen comparison rule.
A valid preregistered quantitative mapping shows an external constraint excludes the required region.
Required preregistered isotope or experiment transfer fails without refit.
Claimed directional effect fails an adequately powered future test with timing, surveyed orientation, frames and active tensor.
